title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: one transfer, to the customer's checking account, on the reactivation date
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when a dormant Savings & Money Market Accounts account is to be reactivated on the strength of a transfer out made by telephone, online or mobile banking in the contact. It states which transfers on the reactivation date allow the date to be established.

## Policy clause

1. The reactivation date is established only when exactly one withdrawal on the account by telephone banking, online transfer or mobile app transfer posted on that date, and its counterparty is a checking account of the same customer.
2. When two or more such withdrawals posted on that date, the records do not show which one the contact made, and no reactivation date is established under this rule.
3. When the counterparty of that withdrawal is any other account, no reactivation date is established under this rule.

## Basis of decision

- **Authority.** The withdrawals posted on the date, their channels and their counterparty come from the savings account's transaction record; whether the counterparty is a checking account of the same customer is read from the bank's checking records.
- **Object correlation.** Only withdrawals by telephone banking, online transfer or mobile app transfer, posted on the reactivation date, are looked at; the counterparty must belong to the customer who holds the savings account.

## Condition table

| Such withdrawals posted on the date | Counterparty | Reactivation date under this rule |
|---|---|---|
| exactly one | a checking account of the same customer | established |
| exactly one | any other account | none |
| two or more | any | none; the records do not show which one the contact made |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- On the date, the only such withdrawal is a telephone transfer to the customer's checking account. The date is established.
- On the date, an online transfer to the customer's checking account and a telephone transfer to the same checking account both posted. There are two, so no reactivation date is established under this rule.
- On the date, the only such withdrawal is an online transfer to an account at another bank. Its counterparty is not a checking account of the same customer, so no reactivation date is established under this rule.

## Points of judgement

**An ATM withdrawal also posted on the date. Does it make two?** No; only withdrawals by telephone banking, online transfer or mobile app transfer are counted here.
